name: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF
adoption: Secure development lifecycle, vulnerability prevention, root-cause recurrence prevention, evidence and supplier communication.
notes: SP 800-218 Rev.1 / SSDF 1.2 is draft; monitor only until final.

name: OWASP ASVS
adoption: Web/API security verification requirements and negative test coverage.
notes: Map relevant ASVS IDs to security and web/API work packages.

name: OWASP API Security Top 10
adoption: Object/property/function authorization, resource limits, inventory, unsafe API consumption.
notes: Use as threat/negative scenario inventory, not as a replacement for CPF security contracts.

name: OpenAPI Specification
adoption: Pin a CPF-supported OAS profile based on generator/tool compatibility; evaluate 3.2.0 without forcing immediate migration.
notes: Specification text is authoritative over schemas. Sanitize Markdown/HTML and handle reference cycles.

name: AsyncAPI Specification
adoption: Machine-readable event/message contracts, channels, operations, bindings, correlation and examples.
notes: Adopt only where tooling and provider contracts are verified.

name: IETF RFC 9457
adoption: Machine-readable HTTP problem details; type/title/status/instance and structured validation extensions.
notes: Obsoletes RFC 7807. Avoid leaking debugging or sensitive data in detail.

name: WCAG
adoption: CPF ADM/BZA target WCAG 2.2 AA with keyboard, focus, labels, error identification and accessible authentication.
notes: Use testable success criteria and browser/accessibility evidence.

name: SLSA
adoption: Source and Build tracks, provenance generation/distribution/verification and protected build platform.
notes: Do not claim a SLSA level without satisfying the exact versioned track/level requirements.

name: CycloneDX
adoption: Final-artifact SBOM plus services, cryptographic assets, data provenance, licenses and attestations.
notes: Generate from final artifacts and verify dependency graph completeness.

name: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions
adoption: Use stable groups by default; unstable groups require explicit opt-in, version pinning and migration/dual-emit plan.
notes: Avoid unbounded cardinality and do not silently break existing telemetry.

name: W3C Trace Context
adoption: traceparent/tracestate validation, trust boundaries and propagation across local/remote/async/batch.
notes: CPF transactionId remains the business execution identity and is correlated, not replaced.

name: NIST SP 800-161 Rev.1 Update 1 and SP 1326
adoption: Supplier/product provenance, resilience, foundational practices, supply-chain tiers and acquisition due diligence.
notes: Apply to OSS, build tools, registries, providers and commercial dependencies.

name: CISA Secure by Design / Product Security Bad Practices
adoption: Eliminate preventable defect classes, default credentials and delayed KEV remediation; make secure defaults customer-safe.
notes: Use as product manufacturer review criteria; preserve CPF architecture and applicable legal constraints.

name: OpenFeature Specification
adoption: Vendor-neutral evaluation API, provider lifecycle, context, hooks, events and tracking with section stability awareness.
notes: Only stable/hardening sections are production defaults; experimental features require opt-in.

name: CloudEvents
adoption: Evaluate compatibility for external/interoperable event envelope use without replacing CPF mandatory business metadata.
notes: Use as an interoperability profile, not an automatic mandatory envelope for every internal message.

name: Spring Boot / Spring Cloud
adoption: Pin an approved stack matrix and fail closed on unsupported combinations.

name: Java 25 / Gradle
current: Java 25 target; Gradle 9.1 supports Java 25; current Gradle 9.x is newer
adoption: Keep the repository-pinned wrapper as source of truth; evaluate later compatible 9.x minors in shadow builds before any upgrade.
notes: Use Java Toolchains. Security-patched JDK builds are required without forcing one JDK vendor.
